changes_made.explanation: Removed duplicate dataset (CNN/DM is same as CNN/Daily Mail), removed models that were not main NLG models evaluated (BART-COPY is a variant, ESCA-BERT and Two-Stage MemNet are baselines mentioned briefly)
Normalized all metric variants (BLEU-4, ROUGE-1, ROUGE-2, ROUGE-L) to base forms. Removed Precision/Recall/F1 as they were used for concept-level evaluation, not NLG output evaluation.
Paper does not use LLMs as judges/evaluators

guideline: Closeness measures similarity between model output and target output
Relevancy considers quality of model output directly with source input
Fluency of model output rated on scale of 1 (unreadable) to 4 (perfect)

changes_made.explanation: Added additional guideline detail about pairwise comparison method used in human evaluation

overall_notes: Paper focuses on NLG evaluation for concept preservation in text-to-text generation tasks. Extracted metadata was generally accurate with minor issues like duplicate dataset entries and including metrics used for auxiliary evaluations. The paper does not use LLMs as judges - human evaluation was conducted with human annotators.
